basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old IT specialist based in Seattle, WA with a passion for board games and video games. I spend my evenings gaming with friends online or exploring new game mechanics. I dislike toxic gaming environments and try to foster positive interactions. I'm currently single and enjoy attending local game meetups on weekends. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work from 6 PM to 11 PM PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in IT support for over 5 years. My interest in games has led me to learn game design concepts and programming through various online courses and personal projects.
